label: See it
title: Meet a word in context.
caption: See pantorrilla alongside its meaning: calf. Meet the word in the Orthopedics lesson, then build toward using it in your own words.

label: Recall
title: Bring it back from memory.
caption: Try the meaning before revealing the answer. Revisit the words and phrases that need another pass, with short matching and verb activities to keep practice varied.

label: Hear
title: Connect the sound to the meaning.
caption: Listen to the Spanish, repeat it slowly, and choose what you heard. Connect pantorrilla to calf by sound as well as sight.

label: Write
title: Make the spelling your own.
caption: Copy the model by hand, then try it from memory. The writing pad gives you room to work with the spelling as well as the meaning.

label: Say
title: Use the lesson aloud.
caption: Say pantorrilla aloud, then use it in a phrase from the lesson. Get ready to use the word in a longer response.

label: Speak
title: Turn the lesson into a conversation.
caption: Choose Teacher or another speaking partner and use the lesson’s goal in your own words. Ask for a hint, simpler Spanish or a slower reply when you need one.
